title: Whale dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ocean glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='42' ry='10' fill='#1b4f7a' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- water splash -->
  <path d='M18 78 Q26 68 34 78' fill='none' stroke='#4fc3f7' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M66 78 Q74 67 82 78' fill='none' stroke='#4fc3f7' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail (behind body) -->
  <path d='M22 54 Q10 40 6 26 Q14 30 20 38 Q18 28 16 18 Q24 28 30 44 Z' fill='#2d8fd5' stroke='#5bb8f5' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='30' ry='21' fill='#3a9de0'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='63' rx='20' ry='11' fill='#a8dcf7'/>
  <!-- back highlight -->
  <path d='M30 45 Q42 36 62 40' fill='none' stroke='#6cc4ff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- fin (dancing up) -->
  <path d='M70 46 Q82 36 84 24 Q76 30 72 38 Z' fill='#2d8fd5' stroke='#5bb8f5' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='60' cy='50' r='3.5' fill='#0a2a40'/>
  <circle cx='61.2' cy='48.8' r='1.3' fill='#e8f8ff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M56 59 Q61 64 67 59' fill='none' stroke='#0a2a40' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <circle cx='67' cy='56' r='3' fill='#f28cb1' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- spout -->
  <path d='M44 35 Q43 26 40 20' fill='none' stroke='#8fe0ff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M44 35 Q46 24 51 19' fill='none' stroke='#8fe0ff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M44 35 Q48 28 57 26' fill='none' stroke='#8fe0ff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- music notes to show dancing -->
  <g fill='#ffd84d'>
    <ellipse cx='80' cy='20' rx='3' ry='2.4' transform='rotate(-20 80 20)'/>
    <rect x='82' y='10' width='1.8' height='10' rx='0.9'/>
    <ellipse cx='26' cy='16' rx='3' ry='2.4' transform='rotate(-20 26 16)'/>
    <rect x='28' y='7' width='1.8' height='9' rx='0.9'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <circle cx='88' cy='44' r='1.8' fill='#fff59d'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='46' r='1.8' fill='#fff59d'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='68' r='1.4' fill='#b3ecff'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='64' r='1.4' fill='#b3ecff'/>
</svg>
